note.zh: 已在云端上线并列出费率，但新版权重对应关系尚待核实，暂不绘图。
note.en: Cloud availability and rates are listed; the updated weight version still needs verification before plotting.
Available as third-party models. The current X Subscription requires prepaid top-ups for them; legacy plans keep separate monthly pools and are labeled Legacy.
note.zh: 第三方模型已上线。当前 X Subscription 需用预付充值额另付费用；原套餐保留双月池并已标记 Legacy，不能套用其额度。

note.en: Catalog and release notes checked through November 4. Explicit named models are offered, but plan docs publish relative multipliers and rolling limits without an absolute standard-credit/token conversion. Ultra Fast is a distinct service variant.
note.zh: 已检查至 11 月 4 日的更新日志、型号与套餐。明确提供这些型号，但仅公布相对倍率和滚动限制，缺少基础信用额/token 换算；Ultra Fast 亦不混同普通版本。

note.en: CLI v1.85.0 announced Beam 1.0. Current promotion is free with no daily request cap while capacity lasts; this is not a guaranteed monthly token pool.
note.zh: CLI v1.85.0 已官宣 Beam 1.0；当前活动免信用额、无每日请求次数上限，但受可用容量限制，不折算为保证月 token 额度。

note.en: October 16 launch confirms Reflection Beam on beam:cloud, temporarily free with ZDR. No guaranteed monthly token pool or fixed end date is published.
note.zh: 10 月 16 日上线公告确认 Reflection Beam 对应 beam:cloud，限时免费且 ZDR；未公布保证月 token 额度或固定结束日期。

note.en: Beam Free is a temporary regional offer; official usage statistics identify beam-1.0-501b-a23b. No guaranteed monthly token pool is inferred.
note.zh: Beam Free 为限时、限地区活动，官方使用统计列出 beam-1.0-501b-a23b。已记录渠道对应，不推定保证月 token 额度。

note.en: Current deals confirm stealth Crouton/Glyph (up to 1,000 requests/day) and Laguna S 2.1 (capacity limited). No benchmark identity is borrowed from other models.
note.zh: 当前活动确认 Crouton/Glyph 每日最多 1,000 请求及受容量限制的 Laguna S 2.1；不借用其他模型的榜单成绩。

note.en: Decision models are available for headless use; output is billed differently from ordinary generation and has no compatible leaderboard observation.
note.zh: 决策模型已支持无界面调用；输出计费与普通文本生成不同，暂无可兼容榜单成绩。

note.en: October 19 cloud launch confirms this decision model. Published input-only billing does not fit the standard cached-text generation workload.
note.zh: 10 月 19 日公告确认该决策模型云端上线；公布的仅输入计费不能套入标准缓存文本生成负载。

note.en: Token Plan Personal explicitly includes these models and removed weekly caps September 22. Credits depend dynamically on model, thinking and tools; published monthly credit counts are not USD or token quotas. The older Coding Plan is a different product.
note.zh: Token Plan 个人版明确提供这些模型，9 月 22 日已取消周限额；Credits 随模型、思考及工具动态消耗，月 Credits 数不能视作美元或 token 额度。原 Coding Plan 为不同产品。

note.en: A weekly recap said 1017, but the dedicated announcement and current endpoint name GLM-5.3 Flash without a separate checkpoint. Preserve this identity; do not invent a GLM 1017 benchmark join.
note.zh: 周报出现 1017 字样，但专门公告与现行端点仍为 GLM-5.3 Flash，未确认独立检查点；保留已核实身份，不虚构 GLM 1017 榜单映射。

note.en: Fast remains a separate service endpoint. The standard DeepSeek 1017 rollout does not explicitly establish the Fast checkpoint; no checkpoint score is reassigned.
note.zh: Fast 为独立服务端点；标准版 DeepSeek 1017 上线公告没有明确 Fast 的检查点，不转移 1017 成绩。

note.en: Official November 3 announcement: one-week free stealth preview, regional restrictions, 1M context. No permanent free quota or identity with another scored model is assumed.
note.zh: 11 月 3 日官方公告：一周免费匿名预览、限地区、1M 上下文。不推定永久免费额度，也不与其他有榜单成绩的模型合并。

note.en: Fable 5.2: Max/Ultra and Team Premium share an allowance capped at 50% of the weekly limit; Pro and Team Standard normally use credits. A launch offer temporarily provides the 50% weekly allowance on Pro/Team Standard through November 16, 2026, 23:59 PT. These are plan limits, not a verified monthly token quota; no subscription price point or benchmark is inferred. The imported Claude Pro sample dated November 9 is a single-window historical extrapolation of the main weekly meter. Its 782M monthly-token estimate explicitly omits the 50% Fable cap and extends the temporary launch period to four weeks; it is not a guaranteed ongoing Pro allowance. The original measurement and assumptions are preserved, not independently adopted as a current quota.
note.zh: Fable 5.2：Max／Ultra 与 Team Premium 共享最多周限额 50% 的额度；Pro 和 Team Standard 通常使用 credits。发布优惠临时为 Pro／Team Standard 提供 50% 周额度，截至太平洋时间 2026 年 11 月 16 日 23:59。这些是套餐限制，不是已核实的月 token 额度，不据此虚构订阅价格点或榜单成绩。 新导入的 11 月 9 日 Claude Pro 样本是按主周额度条推算的单窗口历史记录。其 7.82 亿月 token 估计明确未计入 50% Fable 上限，并把临时发布优惠外推为四周，不代表 Pro 长期保证额度。保留原始测量及假设，不将其独立认定为当前可用额度。

note.en: Mythos 5.2 requires Cyber Verification approval. Eligible individuals and organizations may apply; approved Pro users use credits, while approved Max/Ultra users share the relevant allowance. A paid subscription alone does not establish access. No monthly token quota or benchmark is inferred.
note.zh: Mythos 5.2 须获网络安全验证批准，符合条件的个人与组织可申请；获批 Pro 用户使用 credits，获批 Max／Ultra 用户共享相应额度。付费订阅本身不代表已获访问权限，不推定月 token 额度或榜单成绩。
